newsitem.title: USA: Scientific Games wins Fla. lottery contract.
newsitem.headline: Scientific Games wins Fla. lottery contract.

text.p: Scientific Games Holding Corp was awarded a contract to manage Florida's instant lottery, the state's lottery agency said in a statement on Monday.

Scientific Games, based in Alpharetta, Georgia, offered to carry out the terms of the contract in exchange for 2.4375 percent of the lottery's annual scratch-game sales for 12 years. The bid values the contract at about $107.5 million, the agency said.
Scientific Games's bid was $19.5 million less than the second bidder, Dittler Brothers Inc, the agency said.
